We’re Looking For A: Senior Manager, Retail Marketing

Location: Remote

What You’ll Be Doing: The Senior Manager of Retail Marketing is dedicated to architecting and executing omni-channel shopper marketing, retail media, and merchandising programs across our premier accounts - Walmart, Petco, Amazon, Chewy and others. Reporting directly to the Director of Retail Marketing and working in close partnership with Account Sales Leads, this role co-architects the marketing strategy and Joint Business Planning (JBP) vision to drive brand acceleration and sell-through.
